title: The loop is closed: speak, and a mastermind builds it

text: Live now. Say something that asks for work and the assistant marks it as a task; Servex spawns a Sonnet task mastermind for it (two at a time); the card shows queued, then working with the mastermind's own live line, then landed with the link — or blocked with the reason. Proven: your exact sentence became a real page in five minutes forty seconds for two dollars; a remark got no task.
